description: Land Title Settlement Department -Pasiyawewa, Hingurakgoda D/S Division, Pollonnaruwa  District - Cad. Map No. 120139  and other Title Settlements
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their owners, extent, and title classifications in designated areas. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
